display_long_description:
Welcome to Steal Brainrot: Thief Stealer, a chaotic brainrot adventure that blends action, survival, and simulation into one intense brainrotting experience. In this brainrot game, you live in your own home while brainrots appear on a central platform, pushing you to steal a brainrot as fast as possible and secure it before it’s gone.

Your goal is simple but addictive: steal some brainrot, bring it back to your base, and survive the growing challenge. This brainrot simulation focuses on timing, movement, and smart decision-making as you continue stealing brainrots and improving your runs.

Collect iconic meme brainrots like tung sahur and more while building the ultimate brainrot collection. Stealing Brainrot is all about mastering the loop of stealing brainrots, protecting your progress, and surviving longer each time in this fast-paced brainrot survival game.

Whether you enjoy action games, survival challenges, or simulation-style gameplay, Stealing Brainrot delivers a unique mix of adventure, meme energy, and nonstop brainrotting chaos where the goal is always to steal some brainrot.

Features:

🧠 Steal a Brainrot Gameplay - Run to the platform, steal some brainrot, and bring it back safely in this core brainrot stealing mechanic

⚡ Action-Packed Brainrotting - Fast-paced action gameplay

🏠 Home Base Simulation – Manage your own space and store your brainrot collection
